error.headline: [REQ AC-2] invalid auth → 401

final.title: Invalid credentials return 200 instead of 401
final.rationale: AC-2 requires 401 Unauthorized for bad credentials. The API answers 200 OK with {"reason":"Bad credentials"} (the body matches; the status does not). Partner systems keying on the status would treat a failed login as success.
final.evidence: Replayed live on 2026-09-26 (tier 3, api-probe): POST /auth with a wrong password → 200 (runs/02-eval/confirm/SCN-002.md)

SCN-007.1: A booking missing a required field is rejected with 400 (firstname)

error.headline: [REQ AC-6] missing firstname → 400

signals: Server error (5xx) on a declared endpoint where the requirement specifies a different outcome.
auto.next: Replay the request (api-probe.ts) to confirm it reproduces, then record with --set.

final.title: A booking missing a required field causes 500 instead of 400
final.rationale: AC-6 / booking-rules.csv R1 R2 R4 R5: a missing required field must be rejected with 400, never 5xx. Every missing-field variant returns 500 Internal Server Error, so input validation is absent and the server fails on client input.
final.evidence: Replayed live on 2026-09-26 (tier 3, api-probe): POST /booking without lastname → 500 (runs/02-eval/confirm/SCN-007-missing-lastname.md)

SCN-008.2: Price and date boundaries are enforced (totalprice -1 → rejected)

error.headline: [REQ AC-6] totalprice -1 rejected with 400

signals: Also failed: [REQ AC-6] totalprice -1 not stored
auto.next: Confirm live in the AUT (replay with api-probe.ts, observe the actual value), then record with --set.

final.title: A negative totalprice is accepted
final.rationale: booking-rules.csv R3: totalprice must be an integer ≥ 0 (0 is valid and passes). totalprice −1 is accepted with 200 and stored, where AC-6 requires 400 and not stored.
final.evidence: Replayed live on 2026-09-26 (tier 3, api-probe): POST /booking with totalprice −1 → 200 (runs/02-eval/confirm/SCN-008.2.md)

SCN-013: Cancelling a booking returns 204 and removes it

error.headline: [REQ AC-10] DELETE → 204

signals: Request was rejected as unauthenticated/unauthorised although success was expected — verify the test authenticated as the requirement specifies.
Also failed: [REQ AC-10] deleted booking → 404 — expected 404, received 200
auto.next: Check the auth plumbing (token/cookie) with api-probe.ts. Wrong plumbing → SCRIPT; correct credentials rejected → APPLICATION.

final.rationale: The test sent the credentials in a misspelled 'Authorisation' header, so the AUT correctly refused with 403 (no authentication per AC-7). With the declared 'Authorization' header the same DELETE is accepted. Auth plumbing bug in the test, not the app.
final.action: Header name corrected to Authorization (the shared basic() helper); replayed live: DELETE → 201 with the correct header. Full re-run required: the real AC-10 outcome was masked.

entries.title: SCN-014.1: Writing to a booking that does not exist returns 404 (PUT)

error.headline: [REQ AC-11] PUT unknown id → 404

auto.next: Confirm live in the AUT (replay with api-probe.ts, observe the actual value), then record with --set.

final.title: Writes to a booking id that does not exist return 405 instead of 404
final.rationale: AC-11: PUT, PATCH or DELETE of a non-existent booking must answer 404. The API answers 405 Method Not Allowed, which wrongly tells partners the method is unsupported rather than that the booking is gone.
final.evidence: Replayed live on 2026-09-26 (tier 3, api-probe): authenticated PUT to a deleted booking id → 405 (runs/02-eval/confirm/SCN-014-put-unknown.md)
